Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0093-reverse-03", "row_sha256": "283c805fdc3aa21f571dc2cf9bfa7bf219f2692e5c86e35fdad2c0a136ef342a", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i need to update the warranty record for the washing machine in my apartment because the control panel stopped responding yesterday evening the claim number is 78142 and the appliance is still within the two year coverage period please change the delivery address for the replacement control panel to B46 no sorry A154 that is the correct building location and the unit is on the third floor Leonie is the person who will be there to receive the package so please put her name on the delivery note and have the courier call her fifteen minutes before arriving i spoke with the warranty desk on monday and they said the replacement part could be sent once the address was confirmed i am confirming it now please keep the existing repair visit on Thursday at ten thirty in the morning because the technician also needs to check whether the loose connector caused the panel to stop working the washing machine should stay plugged in but please tell Leonie not to run a cycle before the technician arrives and leave the instruction sheet beside the appliance i can be reached by email if the delivery team needs another detail and Leonie has my permission to answer questions about access to the building", "output": "I need to update the warranty record for the washing machine in my apartment because the control panel stopped responding yesterday evening. The claim number is 78142, and the appliance is still within the two-year coverage period. Please change the delivery address for the replacement control panel to A154. That is the correct building location, and the unit is on the third floor. Leonie is the person who will be there to receive the package, so please put her name on the delivery note and have the courier call her fifteen minutes before arriving. I spoke with the warranty desk on Monday, and they said the replacement part could be sent once the address was confirmed. I am confirming it now. Please keep the existing repair visit on Thursday at ten thirty in the morning because the technician also needs to check whether the loose connector caused the panel to stop working. The washing machine should stay plugged in, but please tell Leonie not to run a cycle before the technician arrives, and leave the instruction sheet beside the appliance. I can be reached by email if the delivery team needs another detail, and Leonie has my permission to answer questions about access to the building."}]
